connector.name: kObsidian
connector.registryDescription: Filesystem-first MCP for Obsidian - an LLM-maintained wiki inspired by Karpathy's LLM Wiki.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package kobsidian-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the bezata account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: OBSIDIAN_VAULT_PATH
env.description: Absolute path to the Obsidian vault this server should operate on.

env.name: OBSIDIAN_API_URL
env.description: Base URL of the Obsidian Local REST API plugin. Only required for workspace.* / commands.* / live dataview.query* tools.

env.name: OBSIDIAN_API_VERIFY_TLS
env.description: Set to 'true' if you've trusted the Local REST API's self-signed certificate.

env.name: OBSIDIAN_REST_API_KEY
env.description: Bearer key for the Obsidian Local REST API plugin (only needed for REST-bridged tools).
